_comment: English profile. The installer copies it to config.json when run with -Language en. config.json is git-ignored.

wake._model: Vosk model folder inside models/ (or a full path). Other languages: alphacephei.com/vosk/models
wake._microphone: Part of the microphone name as shown in Windows, e.g. 'JBL'. Empty = system default.
wake._phrases: Wake phrases. They must consist of words the Vosk model knows — a made-up name will never be recognized, so pick a phrase that sounds like it.
wake._end: Single word spoken last, followed by a short pause. Matched fuzzily.

achaja._comment: Model and effort of the main session. sonnet + low = fast answers; opus + medium = higher quality.

voice._tts_voice: edge-tts voices, e.g. en-US-JennyNeural, en-GB-SoniaNeural, en-US-GuyNeural.
voice._outputs: type=local: 'device' is part of a Windows output device name (empty = default). type=cast: a Google Cast/Home speaker — find its name and address with: python .claude/scripts/output.py discover

agents._project_roots: Folders holding your projects. Every subfolder is a project with its own agent.

home_assistant._comment: Optional. Requires the 'Model Context Protocol Server' integration in HA and a token in state/ha_token.txt.
